g.text: Why the original equivariance term had to be replaced
Synthetic fixtures, not gait. Rho is 0 when mirror equivariant and 4 when mirror blind. The red absolute form cuts its own loss
184-fold by shrinking the head 4.8-fold (left), yet leaves the endpoint within 0.010 of the control (right).
Both scale-invariant forms clear the gate, but parameter_free moves rho by 2.03, so it is the one carried forward.
